title: Panel copy and flag descriptions have a length budget the tests enforce
goal: The design rules say a panel carries at most one short line of text, yet video sections carry paragraphs and experiment descriptions run to 200 words, and nothing checks. Add a length limit the test run enforces, and list every place that breaks it.
notes:
Intake detail (the goal as first filed, moved here by triage 2026-09-23): UX-PATTERNS says a panel carries at most one short line of text, yet video sections carry paragraphs, and flag descriptions run to 200 words. Nothing enforces it. Target: the user's mocks (docs/design/mocks/pages/video.html, video-shell.html, comp-video.html and the page named here) at their fidelity; runner-prompt rules on default config, side-by-side with the mock, labels-not-explanations and right-click apply. Ask throughout: would a Premiere editor get this, and is it easier here?

Filed from the 2026-09-23 video audit in the intake window.
acceptance: Scripts/test.sh fails when a panel section string exceeds the budget (60 characters, tune with the user via a card) outside an allowlist that starts empty for video
Flag descriptions capped (e.g. 40 words) with a test
A list of every existing offender app-wide, the video ones fixed by the panel task, the rest filed

log.note: triage 2026-09-23: goal rewritten in plain language, the old one kept at the top of notes

Measured by the digest pass 2026-09-23: 96 switch descriptions in FeatureCatalog.swift, median 179 words, longest 557 (Turn Into Path), 538 and 520; 92 of the 96 are over 40 words. So a 40 word cap is a rewrite of nearly the whole catalog, not a trim: the card that tunes the budget with the user should show these numbers.
